title: Permission Execution Authorization Preflight
summary: Tests a controlled execution hold for authorization-review readiness while keeping permission grant, authorization, execution, storage writes, canonical writes, public release, and production disabled.

preflight_checks.rule: Starts only from a controlled execution hold whose next gate is permission execution authorization preflight.
Can mark review readiness, but cannot grant permission, approve authorization, or execute.
Requires hold id, founder decision, permission review, prior preflight, instruction gate, authorization review, authorization draft, and source ids.
Storage writes, canonical updates, migrations, accounts, secrets, public release, and production stay closed.
Moves only to a controlled permission execution authorization review gate, never to execution.
Expires on hold, decision, review, preflight, instruction, source, rights, reviewer, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.
